points.description: States that objects are initialized by constructors (a constructor, the special member function called automatically when an object is created). Any wording is fine, e.g. "using constructors".
points.partial_credit: Part marks for a vague or half-right idea, e.g. says initialization happens through a special function or member initialization without naming constructors, or names constructors with a minor error.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that objects are initialized by constructors, in any wording, even very briefly. Part marks if the answer only gestures at the idea (e.g. a special function called on creation) without naming constructors, or names constructors but adds a minor error. No marks for answers that discuss related things (e.g. destructors, assignment, general variables) without saying constructors.
